_meta.demo_area: Rohini / Shahbad Daulatpur, North-West Delhi (DTU area)
_meta.WARNING: Every entry below is a PLACEHOLDER SLOT, not a real record. phone and address are deliberately null. Nothing here is invented - fabricating plausible-looking numbers and addresses would put fake records in front of judges. Fill these in only after you have called and confirmed, then set verified to true.
how_to_fill: 1. MCD North-West zone office or the MCD 311 helpline for: bulky waste pickup, C&D collection point, your ward dry/wet collection schedule.
2. CPCB registered e-waste dismantler list for Delhi-NCR, then call two to ask whether they accept household drop-off or only bulk.
3. A nearby hospital reception for whether their medicine drop-box is live and accepts outside households.
4. Any local kabadiwala for current per-kg rates - these are the numbers in the routing table that move most.
5. One NGO for clothes and furniture collection, asking specifically whether they collect or only accept drop-off.
_meta.priority: Verify lithium_cell, cfl_tube and cnd_debris first. Those are the three where a real ringing number most changes how the demo lands.
_meta.maps_note: maps_query drives a Google Maps handoff in the UI. Curate real named facilities into name/address/phone/lat/lon as you verify them; until then the query at least puts the user in front of real places instead of an empty map.

facilities.name: Local kabadiwala
facilities.notes: Informal sector buyer. Pays cash by weight. Not 'authorised' in the regulatory sense, and that is fine for non-hazardous streams - say so plainly in the UI rather than implying everything needs a licensed facility.
facilities.todo: Find one near the anchor point. Ask current rates for newspaper, cardboard, PET, iron, aluminium.

facilities.name: Authorised e-waste collection point
facilities.notes: Must be CPCB-registered to be shown as authorised. The authorised flag is the whole point of this entry - do not set it true without checking the register.
facilities.todo: PRIORITY. Pull the CPCB registered dismantler list for Delhi-NCR, pick the two nearest the anchor point, call both, ask: do you accept household drop-off, what are your hours, do you take CFL tubes.
facilities.maps_query: authorised e-waste collection centre Rohini Delhi

facilities.name: Battery take-back / registered recycler
facilities.notes: For lead-acid, dealer take-back on replacement is the normal route and usually the safest. For lithium, a registered recycler is the only safe route.
facilities.todo: PRIORITY. Call one inverter-battery dealer about exchange terms, and one registered recycler about lithium drop-off.

facilities.name: MCD construction and demolition waste collection point
facilities.notes: Delhi operates several C&D processing plants. Household-scale malba may or may not be accepted at the plant directly - there is often a ward-level collection point instead.
facilities.todo: PRIORITY. Ask MCD North-West zone where a household takes a few sacks of malba, and whether there is a charge.
facilities.maps_query: MCD construction debris collection point Rohini Delhi

facilities.name: MCD bulky waste pickup
facilities.notes: Bulky items are excluded from normal door-to-door collection, which is why mattresses end up on roadsides.
facilities.todo: Ask whether your zone runs a scheduled bulky-waste pickup or an on-request one.

facilities.name: Hospital medicine drop-box
facilities.notes: Voluntary. The hospital routes it into their bio-medical waste stream. No payment - this entry is carried entirely by the safety framing, so the UI must not show an empty price field here.
facilities.todo: Call one hospital near the anchor point. Confirm the box exists, is live, and accepts medicine brought in from outside.

facilities.name: NGO - clothes and furniture
facilities.notes: Reuse beats recycling by a wide margin for both of these streams, so this facility outranks the scrap route when the item is still usable.
facilities.todo: Find one operating in North-West Delhi. Ask whether they collect from the doorstep or accept drop-off only, and what condition they require.
facilities.maps_query: NGO clothes donation centre Rohini Delhi

facilities.name: RUCO used cooking oil collection
facilities.notes: FSSAI RUCO aggregators mostly serve restaurants. If household collection is genuinely unavailable, say that in the app instead of pointing users at a route that will turn them away.
facilities.todo: Call one RUCO aggregator. Ask directly: do you collect from households, and is there a minimum quantity.
